verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Mistral publishes per-model 'model card' pages for each release (e.g., a dedicated card for the flagship Mistral Large 3 describing it as an open-weight, multimodal, multilingual model) plus supporting docs like model lifecycle and known-limitations pages, showing some transparency infrastructure exists. However, the pack gives no detail on the card's actual contents (training approach, benchmark/evaluation tables, intended-use guidance) and no independent corroboration of card depth or accuracy — missing for 10: documented evaluation-results section, training-methodology detail, explicit intended-use/limitations section, and independent verification of card completeness.
